name: Child Born Out Of Wedlock
overview: Scripture addresses the status and treatment of children born out of wedlock with seriousness and clarity. Exodus 22:22 commands believers not to afflict the fatherless, showing God's concern for vulnerable children regardless of their birth circumstances. However, Deuteronomy 23:2 indicates that a child born outside of marriage was historically excluded from full participation in the congregation of the LORD up to the tenth generation, reflecting the covenantal and communal implications of birth status in Old Testament law. Hebrews 12:8 uses the term 'bastards' metaphorically to emphasize the importance of divine discipline in the life of a true son, distinguishing those who lack correction as illegitimate in a spiritual sense.
